cause: Dorm preview uses 1.35 zoom while follow, locate and bounds used unscaled viewport size. At 1200x800 this places player feet at (810,540) instead of (600,400).
changes: Use viewport/zoom for world-space follow, locate, center, limits and small-map reset.
Convert pointer and middle-button drag pixels into world displacement.
Apply zoom conversion to tutorial focus anchor.
runtime_note: Existing game processes must restart to load edited scripts. World geometry and saved R04 map were not modified by this camera repair.
